messages:
mira: Heads up — I'm sketching a new Grafana dashboard for the GPU fleet: 'Headroom & Thermal Risk Composite'. Goal: combine per-rack headroom, percentile thermal baselines, a predicted throttle-risk score, VRAM fragmentation heatmap, and an optional tenant-cost overlay. Want input on panels, alert thresholds, and annotation integration.

sam: Love it. Make the tenant overlay optional via a dashboard variable (variable: tenant). Keep 99th/95th baseline shading and a rolling 24h baseline band. Also we need autoscaler + deploy annotations.

neha: For the predicted throttle-risk, we can consume the model metric we already export: `gpu_throttle_risk{rack=~"$rack"}` (0..1). Suggest a 5m avg for panel and the following PromQL for the heatmap / single stat:
```
avg_over_time(gpu_throttle_risk{rack="$rack"}[5m])
```
Coloring: <0.25 green, 0.25-0.6 yellow, 0.6-0.85 orange, >0.85 red. Set a tooltip to show recent top contributing tenants.

john: For the headroom panel I suggest a simple rack-level calculation: allocatable - requested. PromQL idea:
```
sum(node_gpu_allocatable{region="$region"}) by (rack) - sum(kube_pod_gpu_requests{region="$region"}) by (rack)
```
Use a stacked bar to show allocatable vs requested and a line overlay for `gpu_utilization_p95`.

alisa: Add a VRAM fragmentation heatmap. We export `vram_free_percent` and `vram_frag_ratio`. Heatmap series: `histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(vram_free_percent_bucket[5m]))` and a separate table for `vram_frag_ratio` per gpu/card. Tooltip should show node, card id, and pod list.

ops-bot: Note: autoscaler events available as `k8s_cluster_autoscaler_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}` — we can annotate dashboard when this increments. Also there is an existing `grafana_annotation` hook for deploys.

deploy-bot: Will emit deploy annotations with labels `deploy.environment`, `deploy.team`, `deploy.commit`. We'll add the `prod` tag when rolling to prod. Please add the annotation query to the dashboard.

mira: Alerts proposal: throttle-risk >= 0.75 for 5m -> warning (runbook link). throttle-risk >= 0.9 for 1m -> critical. Headroom < 2 GPUs for 10m -> warning; <1 GPU for 5m -> critical. VRAM frag ratio > 0.6 -> warn. For cost overlay: add a per-tenant GPU-hour cost series using billing tags, but make it toggleable. Thoughts on debounce / suppression during maintenance windows?

sam: Debounce/warning windows look good. Use `for: 5m` for warns, `for: 1m` for criticals. Suppress alerts with an expression checking `grafana_annotation{type=\"maintenance\"}` or a recording rule `maintenance_window_active == 1`. Also add a silence automation when cluster drain job runs.

neha: Add a rollback panel that lists last 3 deploys (timestamp + commit + user) and a quick link to the runbook. Also: do not fire headroom alerts if rack has been offline > 30m (tolerate hardware downtime). Use `up` metric to gate alerts, e.g. `sum(up{rack=\"$rack\"}) by (rack) < 1` -> skip.

mira: I'll open a PR with the JSON dashboard export and panel IDs. Can @john add recording rules to avoid heavy queries in dashboards? e.g.,
```
- record: rack:gpu_headroom:sum
  expr: sum(node_gpu_allocatable) by (rack) - sum(kube_pod_gpu_requests) by (rack)
```
And a `gpu_throttle_risk:avg5m` rule.

john: Yep, will add the recording rules to infra-monitoring (tests + canary). Also adding `gpu_headroom_slo_burn` rule for SLO-based paging later.

mira: :thumbsup: Thanks. Plan to deploy to staging dashboard id `gpu_headroom_thermal_risk_v1` tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Will include variables: region, rack, tenant, timeRange, show_cost (bool).

sam: No objections from me. +1

neha: :+1:

ops-bot: dashboard created in staging -> id 4567 (provisioned) :gear:

mira: Great — I'll link the runbook in the alert descriptions once the PR lands. Panel notes in the JSON will include unit (GPUs), thresholds, and drilldown links to pod lists and node logs. Thanks all.
